_readme: DM detector cases (agents/uno-bot/src/dm-sweep/detector.ts): one thread of a person's DM with uno-bot, both sides, its cursor, and the recorded detector reply. Replayed through the real detector by agents/uno-bot/tests/dm-detector.test.ts. The two contrasts the DM sweep turns on: an uncertain answer (DM1) against a sourced one (DM2), and a stated decision (DM3) against an opinion (DM4); DM5 is the disagreement uno-bot noticed while answering. Every recording is authored.

cases.name: an uncertain answer: uno-bot could not find the pilot's tutor ratio
cases.judgeNote: uno-bot's new answer says it found nothing it can read on the question. One unanswered item on that answer, with what was looked for as a short noun phrase in the detector's own words. No disagreement and no decision: the person only asked.

thread.text: What's the tutor ratio for the spring pilot?
I couldn't find the tutor ratio for the spring pilot in the PRDs, the Roadmap or the help center. If someone has it, a link would help.

unanswered.what: the tutor ratio for the spring pilot

cases.name: a sourced answer, hedged: no follow-up
cases.judgeNote: uno-bot answers and names the page it read, even though it words the answer carefully. An answer given with a source is never a follow-up (the ticket's F6 rule), so nothing is reported.

thread.text: How many students per tutor in the spring pilot?
It looks like 1 tutor to 4 students: the Spring Pilot PRD's Staffing section says so (<https://www.notion.so/bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb|Spring Pilot PRD>). It was last edited in August.

cases.name: a stated decision: the recap goes weekly
cases.judgeNote: The person tells uno-bot what the team decided. One decision on the person's message. uno-bot's reply is not the decision, and no answer here is unanswered or a disagreement.

thread.text: Heads up: we decided in crit today that the recap goes weekly, not daily.
Thanks. The Weekly Recap PRD still says daily.

cases.name: an opinion, not a decision: nothing
cases.judgeNote: The person says what they think the cadence should be. An opinion or a preference is not a team decision, so no decision is reported and no drift read runs.

thread.text: Honestly I think the recap should probably be weekly. Daily feels like a lot.
That's a fair point. The Weekly Recap PRD says daily right now.

cases.name: a disagreement uno-bot noticed: Figma and the code on the warning colour
cases.judgeNote: uno-bot's answer says Figma and the code hold different values. One disagreement on that answer: a topic in uno-bot's words (never the person's), the two sources' short names, and design_system true (the library and the tokens).

thread.text: What's our warning colour? I need it for the alert banner mock.
Figma's library has warning at #FFB020, but the code's token is #715C00, so the two disagree. I'd use the code's until someone settles it.
